ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First look at the image: this is a DNA electrophoresis gel image; the bands in different lanes moved downward from the loading wells to different positions, indicating that the sample was separated into several bands. Then reason: in gel electrophoresis, DNA is mainly separated according to fragment size/length; smaller fragments move farther, so the characteristic on which this separation is based is size.

method.method_draft: Read the question as asking for the property responsible for separation of DNA in an electrophoresis gel. Recognize from the gel image that the bands represent DNA fragments that have migrated different distances. Apply the rule of DNA gel electrophoresis: fragments are separated primarily by their size/length, with smaller fragments moving farther through the gel. Conclude the characteristic is size.
